description_en: Queries the data of multiple properties of a specified device or digital twin node within a specified time range
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定设备或数字孪生节点，在指定时间段内，多个属性的数据
name: QueryDevicePropertiesData

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Overview page or </ph></props>the ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of data records that can be returned for a single property. Maximum value: 100.
The number of data records returned for any property does not exceed this value
parameters.help_zh:
单个属性可返回的数据记录数量。最大值为100。
任意一个属性返回的数据记录数量不超过该值
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

<notice>
 If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备所属的产品ProductKey。

<notice>
 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name that you want to query.

<notice>
 If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备名称。

<notice>
 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the property records. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1579249499000
parameters.help_zh: 属性记录的开始时间。取值为13位毫秒值时间戳，例如：1579249499000
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of property records by time in the response. Valid values:

0: in reverse chronological order. If you set this parameter to 0, StartTime must be greater than EndTime.
1: in chronological order. If you set this parameter to 1, StartTime must be less than EndTime
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果中，属性记录按时间排序的方式。取值：

0：倒序。倒序查询时，StartTime必须大于EndTime。
1：正序。正序查询时，StartTime必须小于EndTime
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en:
The device ID<props="china"><ph> or digital twin node ID</ph></props> to which the property belongs:

<props="china">
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257184.html operation to query the IotId of a specified device.
In the IoT Platform console, on the Digital Twin Details page, click a twin node to view the Node ID.

</props>

<props="intl">Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257184.html operation to query the IotId of a specified device.</props>

<notice>IotId is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询属性所属的设备ID<props="china"><ph>或数字孪生节点ID</ph></props>：

<props="china">
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257184.html接口，可查询指定设备的**IotId**。
在物联网平台控制台的数字孪生体详情页面，单击孪生节点，可查看节点ID。

</props>

<props="intl">调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257184.html接口，可查询指定设备的**IotId**。</props>

<notice>IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The end time of the property records. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1579249499000
parameters.help_zh: 属性记录的结束时间。取值为13位毫秒值时间戳，例如：1579249499000
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The list of property identifiers.
You cannot specify duplicate property identifiers.
<props="china">
You can view the property Identifier of a device in the feature definition of the product to which the device belongs in the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html to view it in the returned Thing Specification Language model data.
You can view the property Identifier of a digital twin node in the functional properties of the twin node in the Digital Twin Workbench of the IoT Platform console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454999.html.

</props>

<props="intl">You can view the property Identifier of a device in the feature definition of the product to which the device belongs in the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html to view it in the returned Thing Specification Language model data.</props>

If the property of the device is the property temperature under the custom (non-default) module testFb, set this parameter to testFb:temperature
parameters.help_zh:
属性的标识符列表。
不可输入重复的属性Identifier。
<props="china">
设备的属性Identifier，可在物联网平台控制台中设备所属的产品的功能定义中查看，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html，从返回的物模型数据中查看。
数字孪生节点的属性Identifier，可在物联网平台控制台的数字孪生工作台下的孪生节点的功能属性中查看。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454999.html。

</props>

<props="intl">设备的属性Identifier，可在物联网平台控制台中设备所属的产品的功能定义中查看，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html，从返回的物模型数据中查看。</props>

如果设备的属性是自定义（非默认）模块testFb下属性temperature，则参数值为testFb:temperature
parameters.name: identifier

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

NextTime.description_zh: 目前本接口不支持分页查询，请忽略此参数返回值

NextValid.description_zh: 目前本接口不支持分页查询，请忽略此参数返回值

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
